title: Break tasks into small steps
text: Large tasks feel overwhelming. Break each task into steps that take 15 minutes or less, and write down only the very next step.

title: Timed focus sessions
text: Work in short, timed sessions, for example 25 minutes of focus followed by a 5-minute break. Use a visible timer.

title: A simple morning routine
text: Keep the morning routine to three or four steps in the same order every day. Prepare what you need the night before.

title: Visual reminders
text: Put reminders where you will see them at the right moment: a note on the door, an alarm with a clear label, a whiteboard by the desk.

title: Plan tomorrow tonight
text: Spend five minutes in the evening choosing the top three tasks for tomorrow. Write them down and put the list where you will see it first.
